n072055e9bc.headline: investingLive European FX news wrap: Tehran rejects ceasefire, Iran's infrastructure hit
n072055e9bc.summary: European currency markets reacted as Tehran rejected a ceasefire and Iran's infrastructure was hit. The session was covered in a forex news wrap for April 7, 2026.
n072055e9bc.why: Military escalation in the Middle East tends to lift oil prices and drive demand for safe-haven currencies.
n072055e9bc.why_moved: Tehran's rejection of a ceasefire and reported strikes on infrastructure raise geopolitical risk in the region.

ncec162cb37.headline: Tasmania pushes for GST changes
ncec162cb37.summary: Tasmania warned that critical services are at risk unless the federal government changes how the Goods and Services Tax is distributed among states.
ncec162cb37.why: GST revenue sharing determines how much funding Australian states receive for public services and infrastructure.

n935a86b3ff.headline: Taiwan's opposition leader arrives in China for a 'Journey of Peace'
n935a86b3ff.summary: Taiwan's opposition leader arrived in China for a visit described as a Journey of Peace. The trip comes before a Trump-Xi summit where Taiwan is expected to be a top agenda item.
n935a86b3ff.why: Cross-strait relations and US-China diplomacy shape trade policy and risk for semiconductor supply chains.

na387f8c6b7.headline: SGX seeks greater sector diversity in IPOs
na387f8c6b7.summary: The Singapore Exchange is seeking greater sector diversity in initial public offerings. The Monetary Authority of Singapore and JP Morgan Asset Management say a wider investor mix is also critical.
na387f8c6b7.why: The Singapore Exchange operates the city-state's main stock market, and its IPO pipeline affects listing activity and market depth.

n36b43615eb.headline: Housing Crisis in Greece: Structural Problem
n36b43615eb.summary: The Bank of Greece warns the country's housing crisis is structural rather than temporary. It says the problem has serious social, demographic and economic consequences.
n36b43615eb.why: Housing affordability shapes household credit demand, bank lending and the outlook for Greek economic growth.

n88abcce378.headline: Singapore rolls out S$1 billion support package as energy costs rise, expands corporate tax rebates and payouts
n88abcce378.summary: Singapore has rolled out a S$1 billion support package as energy costs rise, expanding corporate tax rebates and payouts. The government said it will not cut fuel duties, calling such measures too blunt.
n88abcce378.why: Fiscal support measures affect corporate cash flow, household budgets and the government's spending outlook in an open trading economy.

n8a6c2a9f80.headline: Industry Seeks Market-Price Subsidies Alongside CO2 Aid
n8a6c2a9f80.summary: EBIKEN urges Greece to adopt the EU's CISAF scheme for energy subsidies, citing gaps in current CO2 compensation for energy-intensive firms.
n8a6c2a9f80.why: Energy subsidy rules under the EU framework determine how much energy-intensive industry pays for power and carbon costs.

n73f6c57db8.headline: Netflix's latest price hike just faced an Italian legal showdown, and customers are getting a a hefty refund
n73f6c57db8.summary: A Rome court has ruled against Netflix in a legal challenge to its latest price hike in Italy, with customers set to receive refunds. Further details on the amount were not given.
n73f6c57db8.why: Netflix is the world's largest subscription streaming service, and regulatory challenges to pricing can affect revenue across markets.

impacts.name: Netflix
impacts.why: Refunds and a legal loss over a price rise can reduce revenue and constrain pricing in Italy.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n3225cd61a3.headline: DOE: Philippines’ fuel supply can last up to 50.42 days
n3225cd61a3.summary: Energy Secretary Sharon Garin said the Philippines' fuel supply can last up to 50.42 days and that pump prices will stay high even if the Middle East conflict subsides, due to damage to Gulf oil facilities.
n3225cd61a3.why: The Philippines imports most of its oil, so fuel supply and pump prices feed directly into inflation and household costs.

n9a712b2901.headline: Vance visits Hungary to boost Orban before pivotal vote
n9a712b2901.summary: US Vice-President JD Vance is visiting Hungary to boost Viktor Orban, who faces his toughest re-election bid yet. The visit comes before a pivotal vote.
n9a712b2901.why: Hungary's government shapes EU policy on sanctions, energy and budget funds, which affects European investment sentiment.

nd8157119ed.headline: Israeli Strikes Reportedly Hit Iran’s Kharg Island Oil Hub
nd8157119ed.summary: Israeli strikes reportedly hit Kharg Island, Iran's main crude oil export hub. The reports raise fears of disruption to Gulf shipping.
nd8157119ed.why: Kharg Island handles most of Iran's crude exports, so attacks there affect global oil supply and tanker routes through the Gulf.

source.name: Pragativadi I Latest Odisha News in English I Breaking News

sources.name: Pragativadi I Latest Odisha News in English I Breaking News

nd8157119ed.why_moved: The reported strikes on Iran's main crude export hub raised fears of Gulf shipping disruption, a risk that typically pushes oil prices higher.

nb7142d919e.headline: India office market records highest-ever quarterly leasing despite global headwinds
nb7142d919e.summary: March marked a historic milestone for India's office market, with record quarterly leasing achieved despite global headwinds.
nb7142d919e.why: Office leasing trends reflect corporate expansion and demand in commercial real estate, a key sector for listed developers and REITs.

nc93444e2c3.headline: KP moves toward cashless economy with digital payment bill 2026
nc93444e2c3.summary: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa government has prepared legislation to transform the province into a cashless economy. The proposed Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Digital Payment Act 2026 is the core of the plan.
nc93444e2c3.why: Digital payment regulation affects banks, fintech providers and how consumers and businesses transact in Pakistan.

n94af823e1e.headline: Singapore stocks falter amid US-Iran stand-off; STI down 0.3%
n94af823e1e.summary: Singapore stocks fell amid the US-Iran stand-off, with the Straits Times Index down 0.3%. Gainers beat decliners 218 to 206 across the broader market.
n94af823e1e.why: The Straits Times Index tracks the largest companies listed in Singapore and is a benchmark for the city-state's equity market.

n799c979834.headline: Oil price hikes take a toll on Cebu tourism businesses
n799c979834.summary: Rising oil prices are taking a toll on tourism businesses in Cebu, with boat owners reporting that operating costs now weigh heavily on their earnings.
n799c979834.why: Fuel costs feed directly into transport and tourism operating expenses, affecting small businesses and the broader Philippine tourism economy.

nc46b300bf0.headline: More records loom as fuel crunch turbocharges EV sales
nc46b300bf0.summary: A record number of Australian motorists are buying electric vehicles, a trend experts say could persist. The shift comes amid a fuel crunch.
nc46b300bf0.why: Electric vehicle demand affects automakers, charging infrastructure and fuel retail. Fuel price pressure is a key driver of the shift.

n9a4c97239e.headline: Changes to regulatory regime in new Bill pave way for SGX-Nasdaq dual listings
n9a4c97239e.summary: Amendments in a new Bill will underpin the Global Listing Board to be set up by the Singapore Exchange and Nasdaq, The Business Times reported.
n9a4c97239e.why: The Singapore Exchange operates the city-state's main stock market, and cross-listing rules shape how companies raise capital and where they list.

nfea17e7cf4.headline: Yen-tervention likely to happen in the 161 to 163 range - Nomura
nfea17e7cf4.summary: Nomura warned that Tokyo intervention in USD/JPY is likely if the pair reaches the 161 to 163 range, and that caution is warranted at those levels.
nfea17e7cf4.why: The yen is a major funding currency, and Japanese authorities intervene in the foreign exchange market when they judge the currency's moves excessive. Intervention can move the pair sharply.

nce7378d4e9.headline: Vietnam's top leader To Lam expands power
nce7378d4e9.summary: Communist Party chief To Lam has consolidated his dominance over Vietnam after MPs elected him as president. Further details were not provided in the candidate text.
nce7378d4e9.why: Vietnam is a major manufacturing and export hub in Asia, and leadership changes shape its policy on trade, investment and state enterprises.

nb947d38950.headline: Wti Oil Price Holds Firm as Inventories Rise and Product Stocks Tighten
nb947d38950.summary: WTI oil prices stayed elevated even as US crude inventories rose by 3.719 million barrels in the week ending April 3. Product supplies are tightening, according to the report.
nb947d38950.why: WTI is the US benchmark crude oil price, traded on the New York Mercantile Exchange, and it reflects US supply and demand conditions.

n0487ff4cd4.headline: What to know about the Strait of Hormuz—and why it matters
n0487ff4cd4.summary: The Strait of Hormuz, a narrow passage linking the Persian Gulf to global shipping lanes, has become the focal point of a major geopolitical crisis. The article explains its significance.
n0487ff4cd4.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of globally traded oil and LNG, so disruptions there move energy prices and shipping costs.

n5d8b01dea8.headline: China sees Qingming holiday spend rise, but per trip outlay dips 0.19%
n5d8b01dea8.summary: Domestic travel spending during the three-day Qingming festival reached 61.367 billion yuan, up 6.6% year on year, while per-trip spending fell 0.19%, according to the culture and tourism ministry.
n5d8b01dea8.why: Holiday travel spending is a timely indicator of consumer demand in China, which affects retail, tourism and consumer-sector earnings.

ndea6d47fe2.headline: Iran Accepts Trump's Ceasefire, Opens Strait of Hormuz for Two Weeks
ndea6d47fe2.summary: Iran agreed to a ceasefire and opened the Strait of Hormuz for two weeks. Iran's Supreme National Security Council said the ceasefire means the war ends.
ndea6d47fe2.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a critical chokepoint for global oil and LNG shipments, so access changes move energy markets quickly.
ndea6d47fe2.why_moved: The reopening of the Strait of Hormuz for two weeks under a ceasefire reduces expected disruption to Gulf oil shipments.

n14029540b3.headline: Singtel, CPF Board to transfer legacy discounted shares to investors’ CDP accounts, giving 615,000 shareholders direct control
n14029540b3.summary: Singtel and the CPF Board will transfer legacy discounted shares to investors' CDP accounts, giving about 615,000 shareholders direct control. The move is rough-gauged to return about six times the original investment.
n14029540b3.why: Singtel is a major Singapore telecom and regional communications group, and its share transfers affect retail shareholder holdings on the Singapore exchange.

nab00a5a942.headline: JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon: Iran war could reignite inflation and keep Fed rates higher for longer
nab00a5a942.summary: JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon warned the Iran war could trigger oil and commodity price shocks, leading to persistent inflation and higher rates. He said private credit likely poses no systemic risk.
nab00a5a942.why: JPMorgan Chase is the largest US bank by assets, so its chief executive's views on rates and credit are closely watched by investors. Inflation and interest-rate expectations shape bank earnings and bond markets.

n87b6175a04.headline: Samsung forecasts insane operating profit growth thanks to surging memory prices
n87b6175a04.summary: Samsung forecasts very strong operating profit growth thanks to surging memory chip prices. The forecast highlights the benefit of rising memory prices to the company.
n87b6175a04.why: Samsung Electronics is a leading global maker of memory chips and smartphones, so memory pricing drives its profits. Its results are a key read on the wider semiconductor cycle.

na05798c811.headline: S. Korea posts largest-ever current account surplus in Feb.: BOK
na05798c811.summary: South Korea recorded its largest-ever monthly current account surplus in February, the central bank said. The result was driven by a semiconductor upcycle and strong exports.
na05798c811.why: The current account measures a country's trade and income flows with the rest of the world and affects its currency. South Korea's exports are heavily weighted toward semiconductors.

n8d6110e1ad.headline: Oil prices extend gains as Trump sharpens rhetoric on Iran
n8d6110e1ad.summary: Oil prices extended gains as US President Donald Trump sharpened his rhetoric on Iran. The Strait of Hormuz carries about 20% of global oil flows, and disruption fears are rising.
n8d6110e1ad.why: Brent crude is the global benchmark for oil, and Gulf supply routes through the Strait of Hormuz are central to world energy flows. Any threat to those routes feeds directly into energy prices and inflation expectations.
n8d6110e1ad.why_moved: Oil rose as Trump sharpened rhetoric on Iran, and the Strait of Hormuz carries about 20% of global oil flows, so supply disruption fears increased.

nc85b24acb3.headline: SGX seeks greater sector diversity in IPOs
nc85b24acb3.summary: The Singapore Exchange is seeking a wider sector mix in IPOs, with the Monetary Authority of Singapore and JP Morgan Asset Management saying a broader investor base is also critical.
nc85b24acb3.why: The Singapore Exchange operates Singapore's stock and derivatives markets, and its IPO pipeline shapes listing activity and market depth. Regulators use such policy to attract capital to the city-state.

n70dd76a041.headline: FAQ: What can I do with my Singtel special discounted shares?
n70dd76a041.summary: Singtel has explained the transfer of its special discounted shares to holders' own CDP accounts. The FAQ covers what shareholders can do with the shares.
n70dd76a041.why: Singtel is Singapore's largest telecom operator, and share distributions affect shareholder holdings and trading. Central Depository (CDP) accounts hold Singapore-listed securities.

n63f7be5939.headline: TCOM SHAREHOLDER UPDATE: Trip.com (TCOM) Facing Securities Class Action After AI Pricing Controversy and Anti-Monopoly Probe Sends Shares Tumbling -- Hagens Berman
n63f7be5939.summary: A securities class action has been filed against Trip.com after an AI pricing controversy and an anti-monopoly probe sent shares tumbling. The lawsuit was announced by Hagens Berman.
n63f7be5939.why: Trip.com is a major Chinese online travel platform, and regulatory probes and shareholder litigation can weigh on its valuation.
n63f7be5939.why_moved: Shares fell after an anti-monopoly probe and an AI pricing controversy, which prompted a securities class action lawsuit.

n7f6e02e591.headline: China's Passenger Vehicle Exports in Jan–Feb 2026: Russia Leads Overall Exports, Brazil Tops NEV List
n7f6e02e591.summary: China's passenger vehicle exports in January and February 2026 saw Russia as the top overall destination, while Brazil led the new energy vehicle export list.
n7f6e02e591.why: China is the world's largest auto market and exporter. Export destinations signal demand for Chinese automakers, including electric vehicles.
